title: Temperature-Adaptive Transformed Teacher Matching
abstract: arXiv:2608.29099v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Temperature scaling is a core component of knowledge distillation, yet its role and effect are still not fully understood. Transformed Teacher Matching (TTM) clarifies the role of temperature scaling by applying it only to the teacher distribution and interpreting the resulting objective as standard distillation with an implicit R\'enyi entropy regularization on the student. However, TTM still relies on a fixed temperature and does not specify how the teacher-side temperature should be adapted for individual samples. In this paper, we introduce a sample-wise inverse-temperature update for TTM by locally minimizing the Kullback-Leibler divergence between the temperature-scaled teacher distribution and the student's prediction. We derive closed-form first and second derivatives with respect to the inverse temperature, and show that they can be expressed using variance and covariance statistics of centered teacher and student logits under t

translated_title: 温度自适应的变换教师匹配
translated_abstract: 温度缩放是知识蒸馏的核心组成部分，然而其作用与效果至今仍未被完全理解。变换教师匹配通过仅将温度缩放应用于教师分布，并将所得目标解释为对学生施加隐式Rényi熵正则化的标准蒸馏，从而阐明了温度缩放的作用。然而，TTM仍然依赖于固定的温度，且未说明教师侧的温度应如何针对单个样本进行自适应调整。在本文中，我们通过局部最小化温度缩放后的教师分布与学生预测之间的Kullback-Leibler散度，为TTM引入了一种逐样本的逆温度更新方法。我们推导了关于逆温度的闭式一阶和二阶导数，并证明它们可以用中心化后的教师与学生logits的方差和协方差统计量来表示。
tldr: 提出了一种针对变换教师匹配（TTM）的逐样本自适应逆温度更新方法，通过局部最小化教师分布与学生预测之间的KL散度，并利用闭式导数（以logits的方差和协方差统计量表示）实现温度的动态调整。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a sample-wise adaptive inverse-temperature update for Transformed Teacher Matching by locally minimizing the KL divergence between the temperature-scaled teacher and student predictions, deriving closed-form derivatives expressed via variance and covariance statistics of centered logits.
